issue.title: Registered Base x402 API is live; looking for first buyer/canary path
issue.body:
Hi Merit Systems team,

We have registered a live x402 v2 API on Base and x402scan now accepts it without compatibility warnings.

Service: BiX Creator Edge
Origin: https://bix-creator-edge.liara.run
OpenAPI: https://bix-creator-edge.liara.run/openapi.json
Paid route: https://bix-creator-edge.liara.run/paid/v1/creator-edge
Price: 0.005 USDC
Network: Base (eip155:8453)

The endpoint returns a standard 402 challenge with Base USDC and includes request + response schemas in OpenAPI.

We are looking for the first real buyer/design partner or a tiny paid canary to validate the full commercial loop. Settlement is intentionally safety-gated off until a real buyer is ready, so no funds are at risk during discovery.

Is there a recommended buyer-facing path in x402scan / AgentCash / Merit tooling to get a newly registered endpoint its first real paid call?

Thanks,
Salman / BiX
